control-implementations.description: Statements about the model endpoints from the 44.1 coverage work (44.1-13): what the extension enforces toward them.

implemented-requirements.description: The extension's route check controls what crosses the boundary to a model endpoint before a request is sent.

statements.description: The extension controls what crosses the boundary to model endpoints. Before a request is sent, the route check judges the content's label against the place the request is going to. When your organization's signed rules list places, content above what any cloud may receive goes only to a listed place: a host the list does not name is refused, and content above a listed place's ceiling is refused before it is sent. A listed place reached over https refuses a plain http connection at every level, and a remote endpoint over plain HTTP is refused. Content that any cloud may receive is not limited to the listed places. CI tests of the route check prove these refusals. What a provider does with a request once it arrives is the provider's.
statements.remarks: Your organization chooses and approves the model endpoints, lists them in its signed rules with their ceilings, and runs the network boundary of its own sites.
